verdict.rationale: Drata has policy management: the pack includes a 'Drata Policy Center' help article and a v2 API 'Create Policy' endpoint. The pack only gives their titles, though, so the specifics of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-app policy editor, policy versioning, approval workflows, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
